scope: .cairn/changes/nested-session-protocol: finite grammar with bounded unfolding, duality, the opaque move-only endpoint resource and a bounded mailbox. Definitions table is handwritten; no lowering/runtime/peer correspondence; the only progress statement is guest-local; nested recursion is regular (the nested parameter is unused); delegation excluded.

theorems.name: NestedSession.dual_is_involutive
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01: duality is definitional and involutive on every node

theorems.name: NestedSession.dual_swaps_send_and_recv
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01: duality swaps Send/Recv on the same ordered message type

theorems.name: NestedSession.dual_swaps_choose_and_offer
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01: internal choice duals to external choice on the same branch

theorems.name: NestedSession.resolve_refuses_exhaustion
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01: bounded unfolding refuses a nested constructor at depth zero instead of accepting it

theorems.name: NestedSession.resolve_unfolds_with_depth
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01: a nested constructor resolves to its named definition rather than expanding without bound

theorems.name: NestedSession.resolve_refuses_unknown_definition
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01: an index outside the closed table is refused

theorems.name: NestedSession.send_step_does_not_observe_a_peer
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: a send step observes no peer; receipt is not modelled

theorems.name: NestedSession.endpoint_copy_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-02: endpoint copy is refused

theorems.name: NestedSession.endpoint_discard_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-02: endpoint discard is refused

theorems.name: NestedSession.endpoint_capture_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-02: endpoint capture is refused

theorems.name: NestedSession.stale_generation_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-02: identity alone does not authorise an operation

theorems.name: NestedSession.matching_generation_is_accepted
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-02: the control keeping the refusal non-vacuous

theorems.name: NestedSession.double_close_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-02: a second close is refused

theorems.name: NestedSession.closed_endpoint_cannot_send
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-02/03: a closed endpoint cannot send

theorems.name: NestedSession.send_step_advances_to_the_continuation
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-04: one step advances exactly to the continuation and nothing outside the protocol

theorems.name: NestedSession.admitOne_is_bounded
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: admission keeps the mailbox depth inside the limit, given a well-formed session

theorems.name: NestedSession.admission_is_bounded
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: a session admission never exceeds the declared queue limit

theorems.name: NestedSession.full_mailbox_is_unchanged
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: a full mailbox refuses by leaving the session unchanged, never a silent drop

theorems.name: NestedSession.admission_preserves_the_endpoint_inventory
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: admission copies and removes no endpoint

theorems.name: NestedSession.no_endpoint_duplication
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: no operation in this model increases the endpoint inventory

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_send_then_recv
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: sequenced send advances the state and observes no peer

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_recursive_entry_unfolds_to_the_send_node
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: recursive entry unfolds to the declared definition instead of expanding

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_orderly_close
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: orderly close is accepted once and a second close is refused

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_bounded_buffering_refuses_the_third_payload
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: bounded buffering stops at the declared limit

theorems.name: NestedSession.send_events_never_observe
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: a send event sequence carries no observation; send is never receipt

theorems.name: NestedSession.receive_after_dequeue_is_well_formed
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: an observation preceded by a dequeue is a well-formed receive

theorems.name: NestedSession.forged_observation_without_dequeue_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 negative control: a forged peer response is refused

theorems.name: NestedSession.orderly_close_with_cleanup_is_well_formed
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: close followed by cleanup is a well-formed orderly close

theorems.name: NestedSession.close_without_cleanup_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 negative control: an omitted cleanup is refused

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_send_then_recv_advances
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: send then receive advances through the closed table (the return half)

theorems.name: NestedSession.closed_endpoint_cannot_receive
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-02 negative control: receive-after-close is refused

theorems.name: NestedSession.both_choices_are_distinct_at_the_boundary
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-01/03: internal choice branches stay distinct and a receive state does not step as a send

theorems.name: NestedSession.typed_send_advances_on_the_declared_type
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-04: the matching ordered message type advances to the continuation

theorems.name: NestedSession.wrong_message_type_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-04 negative control: a wrong ordered message type is refused, not coerced

theorems.name: NestedSession.wrong_order_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-04 negative control: wrong order is refused in both directions

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_internal_choice_branch_one
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: a declared internal branch advances to its continuation

theorems.name: NestedSession.trace_wrong_branch_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 negative control: a branch the protocol does not offer is refused

theorems.name: NestedSession.external_choice_is_not_guest_choice
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-04: external choice is the peer’s, and its dual is an internal choice

theorems.name: NestedSession.enqueue_raises_the_depth_by_one
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: an enqueue raises the derived depth by one under the ledger invariant

theorems.name: NestedSession.dequeue_never_raises_the_depth
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: accounting cannot be inflated by dequeuing

theorems.name: NestedSession.dequeue_of_empty_mailbox_is_unchanged
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: a dequeue of an empty mailbox leaves the ledger unchanged

theorems.name: NestedSession.full_queue_misaccounting_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 negative control: an observation cannot borrow depth the ledger never recorded

theorems.name: NestedSession.accounting_tracks_the_operations
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: the derived depth tracks admissions and dequeues

theorems.name: NestedSession.boundary_preserves_the_committed_prefix
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-06: cancellation, trap, quota exhaustion and peer disappearance only shorten a trace

theorems.name: NestedSession.cancellation_keeps_its_own_event
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-06: a cancelled request stays visible in the retained prefix

theorems.name: NestedSession.peer_disappearance_keeps_the_cleanup_pending
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-06: an unobserved cleanup stays an unresolved fact

theorems.name: NestedSession.ordinary_close_does_not_keep_the_cleanup_pending
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-06 control: the pending fact is cleared only by an observed cleanup

theorems.name: NestedSession.quota_boundary_invents_nothing
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-06: a quota boundary neither completes a pending cleanup nor invents an observation

theorems.name: NestedSession.advance_preserves_the_endpoint_identity
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: the one step helper changes only the state

theorems.name: NestedSession.steppers_preserve_the_endpoint_identity
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: every stepper delegates its successor to the proven helper

theorems.name: NestedSession.different_branches_are_different_traces
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: two internal branches are two traces over the event vocabulary

theorems.name: NestedSession.branch_one_reaches_its_own_continuation
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 positive trace: the declared branch reaches its own continuation

theorems.name: NestedSession.branch_zero_refuses_a_bool_send
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 negative control: a branch the node does not declare is refused

theorems.name: NestedSession.branch_one_accepts_the_bool_send
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03: the declared branch keeps its own typed continuation

theorems.name: NestedSession.bounded_admission_is_bounded
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 full-queue accounting: a bounded admission never derives a depth past the declared limit, given the ledger invariant

theorems.name: NestedSession.admission_at_the_limit_is_refused
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 full-queue misaccounting: a mailbox at its limit refuses the next admission instead of recording it

theorems.name: NestedSession.dequeue_restores_admission_room
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 dequeue/accounting pair: the admission refused at the limit is accepted after one accounted dequeue

theorems.name: NestedSession.unchecked_admission_breaks_the_bound
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-03 control: an admission that ignores the limit derives a depth past the bound, so the bounded operand is load-bearing

theorems.name: NestedSession.step_acts_only_inside_the_current_protocol
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: no action outside the current protocol -- a successful step is exactly a resolved current node declaring that action, and its sole successor is that node's declared continuation

theorems.name: NestedSession.handshake_resolves_without_unfolding
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 finite-handshake control: the ordinary handshake resolves at unfolding depth zero, node by node

theorems.name: NestedSession.handshake_trace_advances
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 finite-handshake control: its two guest actions advance through it and finish

theorems.name: NestedSession.nested_entry_refused_at_depth_zero
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: the nested fixture is not representable at depth zero while the handshake is, so the recursive entry needs an external stack rather than a wider finite table

theorems.name: NestedSession.every_operation_preserves_the_endpoint_inventory
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: every modelled operation (session step, boundary, observed cleanup) preserves the endpoint inventory, including the two that carry no transition

theorems.name: NestedSession.every_operation_keeps_the_endpoint_inventory_bound
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05: hence no operation increases the endpoint inventory, whether or not it carries a transition

theorems.name: NestedSession.duplicating_operation_breaks_the_bound
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 control: an operation that appends an endpoint duplicates one and breaks the bound, so the preserved inventory is load-bearing

theorems.name: NestedSession.guest_local_progress_on_a_declared_action
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 scoped progress: at an open owned endpoint whose resolved node declares the requested action, that action has a successor -- peer, scheduler, queue and delivery are outside the statement

theorems.name: NestedSession.offer_state_offers_no_guest_action
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 scoped progress: a peer-side offer state declares no guest action, which is a named state rather than a deadlock claim

theorems.name: NestedSession.finished_state_declares_no_guest_action
theorems.role: WIT-SESSION-05 scoped progress: a finished protocol declares no guest action, so progress ends in a named terminal state
